key.name: tv-shows-path
key.description: One subfolder per show, optionally split into Season N subfolders.

key.name: films-path
key.description: One subfolder or file per film, named "Title (Year)".

key.name: music-path
key.description: Album folders, optionally grouped under artist folders.

key.name: documents-path
key.description: Top-level folders become collections; loose files form one of their own.

key.name: steam-path
key.description: The folder holding steamapps/. Empty auto-detects ~/.steam/steam, ~/.local/share/Steam and the flatpak install; extra libraries come from libraryfolders.vdf either way.

key.name: pcsx2-path
key.description: The folder holding PCSX2.ini. Empty auto-detects ~/.config/PCSX2 and the flatpak install. Game folders and covers are read from the ini itself.

key.name: online-metadata
key.description: Providers are chosen per section below; albums always use the iTunes Search API.

key.name: films-provider
key.description: TMDB needs an API key; without one, Wikipedia is used.

key.name: tmdb-api-key
key.description: A v3 API key from themoviedb.org → Settings → API. Stored in plain text in dconf.

key.name: igdb-client-id
key.description: A Twitch application client ID from dev.twitch.tv. Used for PS2 game covers and descriptions. Stored in plain text in dconf.

key.name: igdb-client-secret
key.description: The matching Twitch client secret. Exchanged for a short-lived app access token; stored in plain text in dconf.

key.name: workspace-index
key.description: 0-indexed workspace to display media on (the first one in "workspaces" mode, the home menu's in "home" mode).

key.name: columns
key.description: Minimum covers per row; fewer means larger covers.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: How rounded artwork, tiles and the detail pane are, in pixels. 0 is square. The related radii (hero, thumbnails, rows, pane) scale with it.

key.name: player-command
key.description: Command to open videos with. Empty uses the system default application.
